badge.description:
Overrides the badge text, which otherwise counts the data and the selection
("7", or "3 of 7").

hideBadge.description: Removes the badge, leaving the title on its own.

barHeight.description:
Height of the bar in pixels. Values below 1 are clamped to 1, so the bar
cannot disappear.

data.description: The segments, in the order they are drawn.

maxAmount.description:
Cumulative mode only. The value the full bar represents. Any difference
between it and the sum of the data is drawn as the Remaining segment.

mode.description:
Whether the bar shows a breakdown of the data (segments always fill it) or
progress towards maxAmount.

legendValueFormat.description:
"percentage" shows the segment's share of the bar, rounded. "count" shows
the raw value followed by the item's unit, or the chart's unit if the item
has none.

selectionBehavior.description:
What a selection does to the unselected segments: fade them to 20% opacity,
or drop them from the bar and let the rest take the space.

remainingLabel.description: Name of the grey gap segment in cumulative mode.

remainingUnit.description: A unit for the Remaining segment's value alone.

showLegend.description:
Draws the legend below the bar. It is the only place segment names appear,
and the only part of the chart a keyboard can reach.

showLegendValues.description: Shows each item's value beside its name in the legend.

title.description:
A heading above the bar. It is also what makes room for the badge; with no
title, no badge is drawn.

unit.description:
The unit appended to counted values, for items that do not carry one of
their own.

width.description:
Any CSS width; a number is read as pixels. It sets the width of the whole
chart, legend included.

colorGeneratorOptions.description:
Tunes the generated palette (start hue, rotations, lightness range, gamma).
Items with their own color are untouched by it.

selectedIndices.description:
Indices into data that are currently selected. The chart is controlled: it
draws this and never changes it.

onSelectionChange.description:
Called with the next selection when a segment or legend item is clicked.
Without it, clicking selects nothing.

onSegmentClick.description:
Fires on a segment click, alongside any selection change rather than
instead of it.

onLegendItemClick.description: The same, for a click on a legend item.

onSegmentMouseEnter.description:
Called when the pointer enters a segment. The chart already syncs its own
hover highlight between bar and legend, so this is for driving something
outside it.

onSegmentMouseLeave.description: Called when the pointer leaves a segment.

onLegendItemMouseEnter.description: Called when the pointer enters a legend item.

onLegendItemMouseLeave.description: Called when the pointer leaves a legend item.

name.description: The segment's label in the legend, and the key the animations track it by. Must be unique within the chart.

value.description: The quantity the segment stands for.

color.description: Any CSS color. Without it the segment takes a generated palette color, which can shift as categories come and go.

disabled.description: Takes the segment and its legend item out of every interaction: no hover, no tooltip, no selection.

tooltip.description: Content for a TooltipTable shown above the segment on hover. Use it for the breakdown behind the number; a segment without it has no tooltip.
